meaning: MODEL_READY means independently verified named model/protocol; not complete paper or material reproduction

capabilities.name: NMEE
capabilities.capability: E × B → spin magnetization; full finite-frequency multiband/PT response
capabilities.units: H: eV; k: nm^-1; dynamic response: (nm V T)^-1 for s/mu_B
limits: Named AC/static/printed protocols are separate; no completed intrinsic metallic DC extraction
Same-gauge physical spin and position connection required

capabilities.name: Spin transport
capabilities.capability: E / E² → spin polarization and conventional spin current
capabilities.units: e=hbar=1; physical spin sigma/2; BZ measure d2k/(2pi)^2
limits: Full finite-frequency result is not automatically isolated tau^0
Conventional spin current is not generally conserved with spin-orbit torque

capabilities.name: Magnetotransport
capabilities.capability: Spin/orbital PHE and MNHE in the declared paper-model protocols
capabilities.units: Per-channel normalization: see JSON; natural units and selected SI bridges are distinct
limits: General multiband orbital positional shift is not completed
Finite-device conductance is not interchangeable with bulk mixed E/B response

capabilities.name: Curvature–Flux
capabilities.capability: Zeeman geometry, Dirac flux/winding, interband GHE/KME
capabilities.units: hbar=1; source omega=-drive omega; source KME observable sigma/2
limits: Whole Table I not certified; use physical model symmetry checks
Interband response excludes full metallic intraband/collision response

capabilities.name: IGMC
capabilities.capability: Rashba/Dirac conduction and displacement magnetic current
capabilities.units: H: eV; k: Angstrom^-1; explicit Hz/rad/s; plotted SI coefficient A/(m T)
limits: Author Fig2(d) amplitude and complete Eq14 convention remain unresolved

capabilities.name: Ezawa magnetic BPVE
capabilities.capability: 2D Rashba d-wave altermagnet: linearly polarized magnetic injection current from quantum metric
capabilities.units: E/eps0; k/k0; normalized sigma/[tau*e^3/(hbar^2*W*k0)]; no material SI calibration
limits: Only two-band nondegenerate, monotonic-contour clean model with zero-T Pauli occupation
Not a Wannier injection/shift calculator; published x;yy Eq.(19) disagrees with direct Eq.(7) integration; retained as discrepancy

capabilities.name: Orbital IGMC
capabilities.capability: Orbital/spin magnetic displacement current in CuMnAs; explicit printed_D10 and density_A9 protocols
capabilities.units: H: eV; q=k*a; explicit a and Bunit=hbar/(e*a^2); harmonic/phasor sheet current A/(m T)
limits: D10/A9 orbital amplitude inequivalence retained; no unique physical amplitude certification
Fixed orthonormal basis and persistent energy blocks; not general Wannier transport
Low-frequency intrinsic polarization only; zero-T metals rejected; finite-T metals need convergence
In-plane lattice length is an explicit illustrative input; no full-figure or voltage certification
